about_the_role: A structured graduate programme for final-year students and recent graduates. You will be paired with a senior engineer and rotate across two product teams in your first year.
responsibilities: Implement well-scoped features under the guidance of a mentor.
Learn the codebase by fixing bugs and improving test coverage.
Document what you build so the next engineer can understand it.
Contribute to design discussions and ask questions early.
Use version control and code review as a daily habit.
required_skills: Fundamentals of Data Structures and Algorithms taught in an undergraduate curriculum.
Programming ability in Python, Java, C++ or JavaScript.
Understanding of Object-Oriented Programming concepts such as encapsulation and polymorphism.
Basic SQL and the ability to model simple relational schemas.
Familiarity with Git and collaborative workflows.
Knowledge of Operating Systems and Computer Networks fundamentals.
preferred_skills: Any experience with REST APIs or web development.
Exposure to Testing frameworks such as pytest or JUnit.
Experience working on a team project or hackathon.
Curiosity about System Design and distributed systems.
Familiarity with Linux command line tools.
qualifications: Final-year student or recent graduate in Computer Science Engineering or a related field.
A minimum aggregate of 70% or equivalent CGPA.
At least one substantial project that you can explain in depth.
